title: Prompt Engineering Components
summary: This module provides various prompt template classes for constructing and managing prompts, including chat-based, string-based, few-shot, and structured output prompts. It also includes utilities for loading and formatting prompts, enabling flexible prompt creation for language models.

nodes.label: Define Message Prompt Structure
nodes.title: BaseMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all message-based prompt templates, defining the interface for formatting messages and handling input variables.

nodes.label: Define String Prompt Structure
nodes.title: StringPromptTemplate
nodes.description: Abstract base class for string-based prompt templates, providing methods to format prompts into strings or StringPromptValue objects.

nodes.label: Format Individual Chat Message
nodes.title: ChatMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.description: Formats a single chat message with a specified role (e.g., 'human', 'AI') and content, based on a prompt template.

nodes.label: Format AI Message
nodes.title: AIMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.description: A specialized chat message prompt template for messages originating from an AI.

nodes.label: Format System Message
nodes.title: SystemMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.description: A specialized chat message prompt template for system-level instructions or context, not directly shown to the user.

nodes.label: Create Few-Shot Chat Prompt
nodes.title: FewShotChatMessagePromptTemplate
nodes.description: Generates a list of chat messages by incorporating few-shot examples, which can be fixed or dynamically selected, into a conversation flow.

nodes.label: Create Few-Shot String Prompt
nodes.title: FewShotPromptWithTemplates
nodes.description: Constructs a string-based prompt by embedding few-shot examples, using a prefix, suffix, and an example selector or fixed examples.

nodes.label: Create Structured Output Prompt
nodes.title: StructuredPrompt
nodes.description: A chat prompt template designed to enforce a specific output schema (e.g., JSON, Pydantic model) from a language model.

nodes.label: Represent Concrete Chat Prompt
nodes.title: ChatPromptValueConcrete
nodes.description: A concrete representation of a chat prompt value, explicitly listing the sequence of messages it contains for external schema compatibility.

nodes.label: Load Generic Prompt from Config
nodes.title: _load_prompt
nodes.description: Utility function to deserialize a generic prompt template from a configuration dictionary, handling template formats and output parsers.

nodes.label: Load Few-Shot Prompt from Config
nodes.title: _load_few_shot_prompt
nodes.description: Utility function to deserialize a few-shot prompt template from a configuration, including its example prompt and examples.

nodes.label: Format with Jinja2
nodes.title: jinja2_formatter
nodes.description: Formats a string template using the Jinja2 templating engine, with built-in sandboxing for security.

nodes.label: Format with Mustache
nodes.title: mustache_formatter
nodes.description: Formats a string template using the Mustache templating engine.

nodes.label: Select Few-Shot Examples
nodes.title: BaseExampleSelector
nodes.description: An external component responsible for selecting relevant examples to be included in few-shot prompts, often based on similarity or other criteria.

nodes.label: Generic Message Object
nodes.title: BaseMessage
nodes.description: The base class for all message types (e.g., HumanMessage, AIMessage, SystemMessage) used in chat-based interactions.

nodes.label: Language Model Interface
nodes.title: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for all language models, enabling interaction with various LLM providers.

nodes.label: Define Output Schema
nodes.title: Pydantic Schema
nodes.description: An external Pydantic model or dictionary used to define the expected structure of the output from a language model.

nodes.label: Generic String Prompt Template
nodes.title: PromptTemplate
nodes.description: A foundational template for creating string-based prompts, allowing for variable substitution.

nodes.label: Generic Chat Prompt Template
nodes.title: ChatPromptTemplate
nodes.description: A foundational template for creating chat-based prompts, composed of a sequence of message prompt templates.

groups.label: Prompt Creation
groups.title: Prompt Creation
groups.description: Components responsible for defining and constructing various types of prompts.

groups.label: Prompt Base Structures
groups.title: Prompt Base Structures
groups.description: Abstract base classes that define the fundamental structure and behavior of different prompt types.

groups.label: Prompt Data Representation
groups.title: Prompt Data Representation
groups.description: Components that represent the concrete values or structures of formatted prompts.

groups.label: Prompt Loading & Utilities
groups.title: Prompt Loading & Utilities
groups.description: Functions for loading prompt templates from configurations and utilities for different formatting syntaxes.
